name: openclaw-provider-public
description: Development scripts for the Reka provider plugin for OpenClaw

scripts.setup: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefix runtime && ln -sfn ../runtime/node_modules plugin/node_modules
scripts.test: npm test --prefix plugin && npm test --prefix runtime
scripts.clawhub:dry-run: clawhub package publish ./plugin --family code-plugin --owner reka-ai --source-path plugin --dry-run --no-input
